summary: Thimphu district is dominated by forest cover, with 649.28 km² (36.1 %) of its area. Alpine scrubs (340.16 km², 18.9 %) and meadows (277.54 km², 15.5 %) are the next most extensive land‑use classes, followed by rocky outcrops (188.66 km², 10.5 %) and snow and glacier (187.38 km², 10.4 %). Agriculture, built‑up, and water bodies occupy only a small fraction of the district, with 21.46 km² (1.2 %) of agricultural land, 18.56 km² (1.0 %) built‑up area, and 7.92 km² (0.4 %) of water bodies.
